description: Built-in tools that do the same job under different names in different runtimes (claude.ai, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot). Reviewed by hand: a name joins a group only when the tools take the same kind of input and have the same effect. Names are normalized (lower-case). Counting an equivalent can only turn a refutation into ACHIEVABLE, never the reverse.

groups.does: ask the user a question and wait for the answer
edit a file by replacing text in it
find files by a name pattern
